title: Charging Basis for Delivery Attempts on a Northbeam Purchase Order
content:
## 1. What is recorded

Each attempt at handing the goods over on an order under Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment is recorded with how
it ended, and the attempts the fulfilment service includes are made at no further charge.

## 2. When an attempt may be recorded

A delivery attempt, and a fee arising from one, is recorded only while the order stands scheduled, out for delivery,
fulfilled or returned to stock. The standing relied on is the standing shown on the retailer's own record of that same
order, read before the attempt or the fee is recorded, rather than the crew's or the customer's account of where the
order has got to.

## 3. What a failed attempt is charged

An attempt that fails because nobody was at the address, or because the crew could not get in, is charged the
fulfilment service's redelivery fee from the first attempt beyond those the service includes. An attempt that fails
because the crew brought the wrong item, or because the goods were damaged in transit, is charged nothing.

## 4. The two conditions combined

| How the attempt ended | Within the attempts the service includes | Beyond the attempts the service includes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nobody was at the address | no further charge | the service's redelivery fee |
| the crew could not get in | no further charge | the service's redelivery fee |
| the crew brought the wrong item | nothing charged | nothing charged |
| the goods were damaged in transit | nothing charged | nothing charged |

## 5. Points of judgement

**From which attempt does the redelivery fee begin?** From the first attempt beyond those the service includes, and
then only where the attempt failed because nobody was at the address or the crew could not get in.

**Does a wrong item brought to the door become chargeable once the included attempts are used up?** No. Such an
attempt is charged nothing, whatever count of attempts already stands.

**What standings of an order admit an attempt or a fee arising from one being recorded?** Scheduled, out for delivery,
fulfilled and returned to stock.
